text_block_list.text:
In the morning, on my way to the Trainer's 
Room, I spotted Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... In yesterday's drama... there was 
someone who looked like you, 
Trainer-chan...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh! The TV drama, you see! ...It was 
so interesting, and then!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I mean, I never expected such 
an... a-adult scene like that.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! My heart's pounding again! Maya 
won't be able to sleep tonight either~~!

Speaking of that romance drama that aired 
yesterday, it was supposed to be a pure 
love story, but... regardless, it seems 
that's why she couldn't sleep.
